name: VW group MQB coding templates
author: bod3
description: Coding examples for MQB vehicles (e.g. Tiguan AD1/BJ). Module addresses use the usual MQB CAN IDs. Long-coding byte/bit positions differ between part numbers and software versions, so every recipe is unverified: confirm the position against the long-coding helper or label file for your module, and fill in the part numbers before relying on it.

recipes.name: Comfort closing via remote (Tiguan BCM)
recipes.description: Close the windows (and sunroof) by holding the lock button on the key. Long-coding bit in the central electronics (BCM, address 09).
recipes.source: Community long-coding notes for MQB BCMs (unverified template)
recipes.notes: Byte 3 bit 2 is the commonly quoted position for 5Q0937084 BCMs; check it in your module's long-coding helper before writing. Close all doors, keep the key nearby, and test with a window you can stop.

recipes.name: Comfort opening via remote (Tiguan BCM)
recipes.description: Open the windows by holding the unlock button on the key.
recipes.source: Community long-coding notes for MQB BCMs (unverified template)
recipes.notes: Placeholder position next to comfort closing; confirm it for your part number.

recipes.name: Needle sweep on start (instrument cluster)
recipes.description: Gauge needles sweep to full scale when the ignition is switched on.
recipes.notes: Analogue clusters only; the bit position differs between cluster generations.
